colleges.name: Community College of Rhode Island (CCRI)
programs: Welding (14-week, 420-hour non-credit program; SMAW, GMAW, FCAW, GTAW, AWS D1.1 testing)
Fast Track to CNC Manufacturing (Phase 1 earns 13 credits; held at Liston Campus, Providence)
Electrical Apprenticeship (CCRI as RIDLT-approved related instruction provider)
Construction Trades Readiness Certificate (based on MC3 curriculum; OSHA-10, electrical fundamentals)
Advanced Manufacturing and Design - Associate in Science
Advanced Manufacturing and Design - CNC Manufacturing certificates
Engineering, Electrical - Associate in Science in Engineering
colleges.credentials: Welding: non-credit program, OSHA 10, AWS D1.1 performance qualification testing. CNC: Phase 1 earns 13 college credits and OSHA-10. Construction Trades Readiness: certificate. Also AS and certificate awards in advanced manufacturing; AS in engineering electrical.

unions.name: Rhode Island Construction Training Academy (RICTA)
unions.description: Apprenticeship training program for construction trades, closely affiliated with Associated Builders and Contractors of Rhode Island.
unions.how_to_apply: Classes begin each September, two nights a week 6-9pm. 2026/2027 apprenticeship registration is open per the home page; online and paper registration forms are linked. Contact Director of Education and Apprenticeship Nicole Foley at 401-205-2053. School address 249 Roosevelt Avenue, Lower Level, Pawtucket.

unions.name: IBEW Local 99 Joint Apprenticeship and Training Committee (JATC)
unions.description: IBEW Local 99 electrician apprenticeship program run through the JATC; the NECA/IBEW joint program is also described on the JATC page.
unions.how_to_apply: Page says entry-level applications are currently closed and to watch for next application dates. Applications carry a $25 fee (card, money order or certified check). Applications are begun at the Training Facility. Registered apprentices from other programs and completed pre-apprenticeship graduates may apply with documentation.

unions.name: Associated Builders and Contractors Rhode Island Chapter (ABC RI)
unions.description: Rhode Island chapter of Associated Builders and Contractors, a merit-shop construction contractor association; closely affiliated with RICTA.

unions.name: RI Department of Labor and Training - Apprenticeship
unions.description: State overview of Registered Apprenticeship, which combines paid on-the-job learning with related instruction and a nationally recognized credential.
unions.how_to_apply: Page has 'Become an Apprentice' and 'Register an Apprenticeship' sections (https://dlt.ri.gov/individuals/become-apprentice).

unions.name: CCRI Office of Apprenticeships
unions.description: CCRI office that connects students and employers with Registered Apprenticeships and related instruction.
unions.how_to_apply: Separate 'For Students' and 'For Employers' sections on the page.

funding.name: Rhode Island Promise
funding.provides: Tuition-free associate degree education at CCRI for eligible Rhode Island students coming right out of high school.
funding.eligibility: Must be a Rhode Island resident; maintain at least a 2.5 GPA to keep the scholarship for two years (per page).
funding.amount: Tuition and mandatory fees (remaining cost after other aid)
funding.how_to_apply: Submit the Free Application for Enrollment to CCRI; complete enrollment steps after acceptance.
